about.title: Biggs Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Biggs is small enough that a death touches nearly everyone. Roughly 1,700 people live here, and when a family on E Street or out along the Midway loses someone to another party's negligence, the ripple is felt across town. In the most recent final crash year, 2025, Butte County records list no injury collisions and no traffic deaths inside Biggs. Yet wrongful death claims are not only about local roads. Residents commute along SR-99 to jobs and appointments in neighboring towns, and most receive hospital care outside Biggs. A fatal crash on the highway, a workplace accident, a fall on someone else's property, or a medical error can each give rise to a civil claim. California allows a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children to bring that action first, with certain dependents and heirs eligible if no such relatives exist. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks when a government entity is involved. LawProactive connects you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who can review what happened.

whyChoose.title: Why Biggs Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California gives a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a claim, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where your family stands before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is real
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be brought within two years of the date of death, and claims involving a city, county, or state agency carry much shorter notice deadlines. Early contact protects that window.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: Our service costs nothing, and the independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency. Your family's attention can stay on grieving, not on legal bills.

items.question: Biggs recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Does a wrongful death claim still apply to us?
items.answer: Yes. The 2025 figures cover collisions inside Biggs only, and many residents drive SR-99 or the Midway daily to reach work and medical care elsewhere in Butte County. Wrongful death claims also arise from workplace incidents, care-facility negligence, and unsafe property, none of which appear in crash counts. Where the death occurred matters less than whether someone else's carelessness caused it.

items.question: Is a wrongful death case the same as criminal charges against the person responsible?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death action is a civil case brought by the family to recover losses, while any criminal case is pursued by the district attorney to punish the wrongdoer. The two proceed separately, and a civil claim can move forward even if no charges are filed or the criminal case ends without a conviction.

items.question: What losses can our family actually recover?
items.answer: California law allows recovery of funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. The specific amount depends on the facts of each family, so no one can responsibly predict a figure at the outset. An independent attorney can walk through how each category applies to your situation.
